maya: UI crit — conversation rail compact mode looks good but streaming jitter when tokens append; feels jumpy when focus is lost
jon: Can you share a short video? gif would help :eyes:
maya: https://redwood.screenshots/conv-rail-031.mp4 — repro on chrome, when rapid tokens come in scroll snaps to bottom and the input loses cursor
sam: I saw similar on mobile, we should debounce auto-scroll and preserve caret position. also consider a 'pause stream' affordance next to stop button
maya: Proposal: replace 'Stop' with 'Interrupt' — less scary, keeps semantics. 'Regenerate' -> 'Retry' (shorter) — thoughts?
eva: +1 to Interrupt. 'Stop' sounds like cancel and clears state. Copy tweak also impacts analytics naming
jon: For toolbar: compact inline controls: [Interrupt][Retry][...] . If stream is paused, show a subtle pulse indicator and allow step-forward token playback
design-bot: A11y check: buttons need aria-labels, keyboard focus order must be preserved when rail collapses. Screen reader should announce 'Streaming paused' state
maya: Minor: token counter should show 'used / limit' vs raw tokens e.g., '87 / 2048 tokens' and be tooltipable with cost estimate
sam: Can we show per-message token delta on hover? helpful for prompt authors
eva: Also add high-contrast focus outline and ensure colorblind-safe palette for streaming progress
jon: engineering note: batching + streaming interplay tricky — when we debounce scroll we mustn't increase end-to-end latency. suggest 50ms coalesce
maya: I'll add mocks in Figma and PR for copy. assigning @sam for feasibility and @jon for perf check
sam: I'll prototype scroll debounce and caret preserve by EOD, will post snippet
sam: snippet:
```js
// coalesce scroll updates
let pending = false;
function onNewTokens(tokens){
  buffer.push(tokens);
  if(!pending){
    pending = true;
    setTimeout(()=>{ flushBuffer(); pending=false },50);
  }
}
```
jon: looks good — watch memory for long outputs; maybe cap buffer size
maya: Thanks all. quick follow-ups: add accessible label to token counter, change copy text, implement 'pause' visual. I'll open a small RFC and tag product/design
eva: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: design-system v2.14 deployed to staging — contains 'interrupt' button variant
maya: I'll test on staging once deployed
